items.title: Thorn and Zumtobel light the future of learning at Coláiste na Mí
items.summary: Thorn and Zumtobel supplied a phased lighting scheme for the Coláiste na Mí education campus, covering teaching, social and specialist spaces with an emphasis on flexibility as the site expands.

items.title: A New Software Platform For Lighting Manufacturers
items.summary: Electrify Connect is a new unified software platform aimed at lighting manufacturers, merging configurators, CRM, product data management and spec-sheet generation into one system for reps and specifiers.

items.title: Glamox wins contract to light Formosa 4 wind farm in Taiwan
items.summary: Glamox will supply over 900 marine-rated luminaires for transition pieces on up to 35 turbine foundations at Taiwan's Formosa 4 offshore wind farm, a large-scale marine and industrial lighting contract.
